property_summary: For any caller who is not the lender of a loan and any non-zero delegate, approveTransfer must not store an approval (it reverts in P), whereas the mutant lets any caller write approvals[loanID], so approvals[loanID] stays address(0) in P but becomes the chosen address in M.
change_summary: Remove the only-lender access check so any caller can set approvals[loanID_].
